text: Completed local locked Python/Nilearn proof using Python 3.11.13 with numpy 1.26.4, scipy 1.13.1, Nilearn 0.12.1, and fmrimod f3dd9dbf. Live regeneration exposed and fixed regenerate_receipts.sh incorrectly using -S, which hid installed site packages; portable PR checks still use -S independently. Regeneration wrote the JSON/Scala pair, then all 9 receipt checks and 32 manifest entries passed. PublicFContrast and pipeline scenarios pass 2/2 on JVM and 2/2 on JS. Scheduled nightly/manual release workflow is configured from the checked-in lock; no remote run is claimed because this work is not published.
